Professional Profile

Third-year Computer Science student at ENSEEIHT, with a background in mathematics and numerical optimization. I train language models from scratch, on a single desktop GPU. My latest, HilbertLM, was written end to end: custom tokenizer, pre-training, fine-tuning, then a live chatbot anyone can talk to. Now I want to build and deploy LLM and agentic systems in production, and fine-tune models for the teams that use them.

Professional Experience
Research Engineer Intern — Optimal Control & Scientific Computing
Jun-Aug 2025
IRIT / ENSEEIHT · Toulouse
Julia · JuMP
  • Enhanced and validated an open-source Julia optimal-control solver library, across two axes: software maintenance (bug fixing) and numerical validation.
  • Built an automated benchmark looping over 15 control problems: convergence checks for both the solver and JuMP (reference Julia modeling language), initialization comparison, and relative error in the L² norm on the state x and control u between the two solvers.
  • Investigated an Earth-to-Moon transfer modeled as the Restricted Three-Body Problem (CR3BP); implemented regularization to smooth singularities and scoped solver limitations for future work.
  • Contributed unit tests & API documentation via GitHub (commits, Pull Requests, peer reviews), positive team feedback for surfacing critical bugs.
